name: FineWeb
quality: 从 96 批 Common Crawl 清洗，附教育向子集 FineWeb-Edu；清洗步骤有公开报告。
caveat: 网页语料仍有噪声、重复与低质页；训练前要做语言筛选、去重和许可复核。

en.name: FineWeb
en.quality: Cleaned from 96 Common Crawl dumps, with an education-oriented FineWeb-Edu subset; the cleaning pipeline has a public report.
en.caveat: Web text still contains noise, duplicates and low-quality pages. Filter by language, deduplicate and re-check licences before training.

name: Dolma
quality: AI2 公开的研究语料，定位是给科研提供可复现的对照底座。
caveat: 3T 是清洗后的口径；网页来源仍可能含敏感或侵权内容，使用前按用途复核。

en.name: Dolma
en.quality: AI2’s public research corpus, positioned as a reproducible baseline for research.
en.caveat: The 3T figure is post-cleaning. Web sources may still contain sensitive or infringing material; review for your use case.

name: RedPajama-Data-v2
languages: 英 / 德 / 法 / 西 / 意
quality: 多语言网页语料，带质量信号与去重标记，适合做多语言预训练基线。
caveat: 30T 是原始规模，清洗后可用量取决于质量筛选；不同语言覆盖不均。

en.name: RedPajama-Data-v2
en.quality: Multilingual web corpus with quality signals and deduplication flags, suitable as a multilingual pretraining baseline.
en.caveat: 30T is the raw scale; usable volume depends on quality filtering, and language coverage is uneven.

name: OpenAssistant OASST1
quality: 人工编写的多轮对话树，带审核与语言标签，适合做对话 SFT 的起点。
caveat: 社区众包，质量参差；不同语言样本量差异大，直接混合会偏英文。

en.name: OpenAssistant OASST1
en.quality: Human-written multi-turn conversation trees with review and language tags; a useful starting point for dialogue SFT.
en.caveat: Community crowdsourced, so quality varies; sample sizes differ sharply by language, and naive mixing skews English.

name: Databricks Dolly 15k
commercial: 允许，衍生作品需同样开放
quality: Databricks 员工人工编写，覆盖问答、生成、摘要、信息抽取等类别。
caveat: CC-BY-SA 有传染性；如果你把数据混进训练集，衍生数据的分发方式要先看许可。

en.name: Databricks Dolly 15k
en.commercial: Allowed; derivative works must stay open
en.quality: Written by Databricks employees and covering Q&A, generation, summarisation and extraction.
en.caveat: CC-BY-SA is copyleft. If you mix it into a training set, check how derivative data may be distributed.

name: FLAN Collection
size: 约 1,836 个任务 / 1,500 万级样本
quality: 把大量 NLP 任务改写成指令格式，任务覆盖面广，适合做指令微调的对照基线。
caveat: 任务模板高度统一，直接拿去训对话模型会显得机械；需要重采样与模板多样化。

en.name: FLAN Collection
en.quality: Rewrites many NLP tasks as instructions; broad task coverage makes it a strong instruction-tuning baseline.
en.caveat: Task templates are highly uniform, so a dialogue model trained directly on it can sound mechanical. Resample and diversify templates.

name: Anthropic HH-RLHF
quality: 有帮助性与无害性两组人类偏好数据，是 RLHF 早期常用的公开基线。
caveat: 对话风格与现在的助手产品差异较大；直接拿旧偏好训新模型，可能学到过时的表达。

en.name: Anthropic HH-RLHF
en.quality: Human preference data split into helpfulness and harmlessness; an early public baseline for RLHF.
en.caveat: Dialogue style differs from current assistants. Training a new model on old preferences can teach outdated phrasing.

name: UltraFeedback
size: 约 6.4 万条 prompt × 4 个回答
quality: 用多个模型生成回答再做细粒度评分，适合做偏好对齐与 DPO 训练。
caveat: 评分由模型产生，会带入评分模型的偏好；用于生产前要抽检偏差。

en.name: UltraFeedback
en.quality: Multiple models generate answers that are then fine-grained scored; useful for preference alignment and DPO.
en.caveat: Scores come from models and carry the scorer’s preferences. Sample for bias before production use.

name: Nectar
size: 约 18.3 万条 prompt，每组 7 个回答
quality: GPT-4 对多个模型回答做 7 档排序，适合研究排序式偏好学习。
caveat: 排序由单一模型完成，存在位置偏差与风格偏好；不要当作人类真值。

en.name: Nectar
en.quality: GPT-4 ranks seven model answers on a seven-point scale; useful for studying ranked preference learning.
en.caveat: Ranking is done by one model, with position and style bias. Do not treat it as human ground truth.

name: MMLU
size: 约 1.4 万道测试题 / 57 学科
quality: 覆盖 57 个学科的多选题，是模型知识广度的常用基线。
caveat: 题目公开已久，污染风险高；分数高不等于会做实际任务。

en.name: MMLU
en.quality: Multiple-choice questions across 57 subjects; a common baseline for breadth of model knowledge.
en.caveat: Questions have been public for years, so contamination risk is high. A high score does not prove the model can do real tasks.

name: GSM8K
quality: 题目短、答案唯一，适合观察多步算术与推理链是否稳定。
caveat: 难度集中在小学范围；高分不代表能处理真实业务里的表格与多约束问题。

en.name: GSM8K
en.quality: Short problems with unique answers, useful for checking multi-step arithmetic and reasoning stability.
en.caveat: Difficulty is limited to grade-school maths. A high score does not imply handling tables and multiple constraints in real work.

name: HumanEval
quality: 函数级代码生成基准，用单元测试判分，口径清楚。
caveat: 题量小，单一语言；分数波动大，不能单独代表代码能力。

en.name: HumanEval
en.quality: Function-level code generation scored by unit tests, with a clear protocol.
en.caveat: Small and single-language; scores fluctuate and cannot represent code capability on their own.

name: Natural Questions
quality: 来自真实搜索查询，附 Wikipedia 段落标注，适合做检索与阅读理解的联合评测。
caveat: 维基页面会变，旧标注可能对不上；做 RAG 评测要固定快照。

en.name: Natural Questions
en.quality: Real search queries with Wikipedia passage annotations, useful for joint retrieval and reading evaluation.
en.caveat: Wikipedia pages change and old annotations may not align. Fix a snapshot for RAG evaluation.

name: HotpotQA
quality: 需要跨两段以上证据才能回答，适合测检索召回与证据拼接。
caveat: 部分问题依赖维基结构；真实文档库的噪声与权限问题它不覆盖。

en.name: HotpotQA
en.quality: Questions require evidence from two or more passages, useful for testing retrieval recall and evidence stitching.
en.caveat: Some questions depend on Wikipedia structure. It does not cover noise and permissions in a real document store.

name: BEIR
quality: 跨领域检索基准集合，适合比较 embedding 与检索策略的泛化。
caveat: 各子集许可与领域不同；不要把 18 个分数平均成一个总分。

en.name: BEIR
en.quality: A cross-domain retrieval benchmark for comparing embedding and retrieval generalisation.
en.caveat: Subsets have different licences and domains. Do not average all 18 scores into one number.

name: LAION-5B
license: 元数据 CC-BY-4.0；图像版权随源站
commercial: 元数据可用；图像需逐源核对
access: 元数据下载 / 图像需回源
quality: 大规模图文对，适合研究对比学习与图文检索。
caveat: 不托管图像；URL 会失效，图像许可与肖像权要逐条核对，不能默认可商用。

en.name: LAION-5B
en.license: Metadata CC-BY-4.0; image copyright follows the source site
en.commercial: Metadata usable; images need source-by-source review
en.access: Metadata download / images fetched from source
en.quality: Large-scale image-text pairs for contrastive learning and image-text retrieval research.
en.caveat: Images are not hosted; URLs break and image licences and portrait rights must be checked individually. Do not assume commercial use.

name: DataComp-1B
commercial: 元数据可用；图像需逐源核对
quality: 固定训练预算下比较数据筛选方法，适合做可复现的缩放实验。
caveat: 图像不随数据集重新分发；商用前要核对源站许可与肖像权。

en.name: DataComp-1B
en.commercial: Metadata usable; images need source-by-source review
en.quality: Compares data-filtering methods under a fixed training budget, enabling reproducible scaling experiments.
en.caveat: Images are not redistributed with the dataset. Check source licences and portrait rights before commercial use.

name: COCO Captions
size: 约 33 万张图 / 每图 5 条描述
license: 标注 CC-BY-4.0；图像随 Flickr 源站
commercial: 标注可用；图像需逐张核对
quality: 图像描述的标准基线，标注格式稳定，适合做小规模对照。
caveat: 图像来自 Flickr，许可不统一；不能把整个数据集默认成商用可分发。

en.name: COCO Captions
en.license: Annotations CC-BY-4.0; images follow Flickr sources
en.commercial: Annotations usable; images need per-image review
en.quality: A standard captioning baseline with stable annotation format, suitable for small controlled comparisons.
en.caveat: Images come from Flickr with mixed licences. Do not treat the whole dataset as commercially redistributable.

name: The Stack
size: 约 3TB 去重代码 / 300+ 语言
license: MIT（数据集打包）；代码随原仓库
quality: 从公开 GitHub 仓库抽取并去重，附许可与仓库元数据。
caveat: 代码许可混杂，含 copyleft 与无许可仓库；训练与分发前必须过滤。

en.name: The Stack
en.license: MIT (dataset packaging); code follows the original repositories
en.quality: Extracted from public GitHub repositories and deduplicated, with licence and repository metadata.
en.caveat: Code licences are mixed, including copyleft and unlicensed repositories. Filter before training and distribution.

name: StarCoderData
size: 约 2,500 亿代码 token / 80+ 语言
license: Apache-2.0（数据集打包）；代码随原仓库
quality: StarCoder 系列所用代码语料，语言覆盖广，附去重与许可过滤记录。
caveat: 数据集打包许可不等于代码许可；生成代码的许可证继承问题要单独评估。

en.name: StarCoderData
en.license: Apache-2.0 (dataset packaging); code follows the original repositories
en.quality: The code corpus used by StarCoder, with broad language coverage and deduplication and licence-filtering records.
en.caveat: The dataset packaging licence is not the code licence. Assess licence inheritance for generated code separately.

name: PubMedQA
size: 约 27.3 万条生物医学问答
quality: 从 PubMed 摘要构造的是/否/不确定问答，适合做医学文献检索问答的基线。
caveat: 不是临床指南，不能用于诊断建议；专业用途要另行核对最新文献与监管要求。

en.name: PubMedQA
en.quality: Yes/no/maybe questions built from PubMed abstracts; a baseline for biomedical literature QA.
en.caveat: Not a clinical guideline and must not be used for diagnosis. Professional use requires current literature and regulatory review.

name: UltraChat 200k
quality: 由模型生成的多轮对话， topic 覆盖广，适合做对话 SFT 的合成基线。
caveat: 合成数据会放大生成模型的风格与错误；要混入人工数据并做去重与质量过滤。

en.name: UltraChat 200k
en.quality: Model-generated multi-turn dialogue with broad topic coverage; a synthetic baseline for dialogue SFT.
en.caveat: Synthetic data amplifies the generator’s style and errors. Mix with human data and deduplicate and filter.

name: WizardLM Evol-Instruct
quality: 用 Evol-Instruct 把简单指令改写成更深、更复杂版本，适合做指令难度爬坡。
caveat: 合成指令可能不自然或不可执行；训练前要抽检并去掉重复模板。

en.name: WizardLM Evol-Instruct
en.quality: Evol-Instruct rewrites simple instructions into deeper, more complex versions, useful for increasing instruction difficulty.
en.caveat: Synthetic instructions can be unnatural or unexecutable. Sample and remove repeated templates before training.

name: OpenHermes-2.5
quality: 混合合成与公开指令数据，覆盖广，是社区常用的 SFT 基线。
caveat: 来源混合，重复与低质样本多；需按来源分层抽样并做去重。

en.name: OpenHermes-2.5
en.quality: A mix of synthetic and public instruction data with broad coverage; a common community SFT baseline.
en.caveat: Mixed provenance means duplicates and low-quality samples. Stratify by source and deduplicate.

name: DCLM-Baseline
quality: 从 Common Crawl 清洗，附 DCLM 过滤模型与消融报告；强调质量过滤，不是单纯扩量。
caveat: 网页语料仍有版权、噪声与重复；过滤模型会带入自身偏差，不能把过滤分当质量真值。
firstUse: 先拉 1–5 GB 抽样，跑语言识别、去重、毒性抽检，再决定是否进训练管线。
pitfalls: 把 DCLM 分数当通用质量真值；忽略 Common Crawl 的 robots 与来源条款。
cost: 全量下载与训练成本高；抽样验证成本低。
notFor: 不适合需要逐条授权证明的闭源商用语料。
compare: 与 FineWeb 同属网页预训练语料；DCLM 更强调过滤消融，FineWeb 提供教育向子集。
verify: 在数据集卡核对 1.0 版本、token 数与许可；抽 100 条看语言与正文质量。

en.name: DCLM-Baseline
en.quality: Cleaned Common Crawl with a DCLM filter model and ablation reports; the emphasis is quality filtering rather than raw scale.
en.caveat: Web text still carries copyright, noise and duplication. The filter model carries its own bias; a filter score is not a ground-truth quality label.
en.firstUse: Pull a 1–5 GB sample first; run language ID, deduplication and toxicity checks before adding it to a training pipeline.
en.pitfalls: Treating the DCLM score as a universal quality truth; ignoring Common Crawl robots and source terms.
en.cost: Full download and training are expensive; sample validation is cheap.
en.notFor: Not for closed-source commercial corpora that require item-by-item licensing proof.
en.compare: A web pretraining corpus like FineWeb; DCLM emphasises filter ablations, while FineWeb offers an education-focused subset.
en.verify: Check version 1.0, token count and licence on the dataset card; sample 100 records for language and body quality.

name: The Pile
quality: 22 个子集的经典混合，适合做小模型消融和研究复现。
caveat: 构建于 2020 年，网页与代码数据已过时；部分子集许可与来源需要逐项复核。
firstUse: 先选 3–5 个子集做小规模消融，不要直接全量混入新模型。
pitfalls: 把“开源”当“全部可商用”；忽略子集之间的时间与领域偏差。
cost: 全量约 800 GB；子集抽样成本低。
notFor: 不适合作为 2026 年新模型的唯一预训练语料。
compare: 与 RedPajama-v2 / DCLM 相比，Pile 更老、更小，但子集结构清楚，适合复现实验。
verify: 逐个核对子集的数据卡与许可；抽 50 条看正文与元数据。

en.name: The Pile
en.license: MIT (code); each subset has its own terms
en.quality: A classic 22-subset mixture for small-model ablations and research reproduction.
en.caveat: Built in 2020, so web and code data are dated; several subsets have separate licences and provenance that need review.
en.firstUse: Pick 3–5 subsets for a small ablation first; do not mix the full corpus into a new model.
en.pitfalls: Treating “open source” as “fully commercially usable”; ignoring time and domain skew between subsets.
en.cost: About 800 GB in full; subset sampling is cheap.
en.notFor: Not suitable as the only pretraining corpus for a new 2026 model.
en.compare: Older and smaller than RedPajama-v2 / DCLM, but its clear subset structure makes experiments reproducible.
en.verify: Check each subset’s dataset card and licence; sample 50 records for body text and metadata.

name: Tülu 3 SFT Mixture
size: 约 100 万+ 指令样本
quality: 把多个公开 SFT 集按配方混合，附 Tülu 3 训练报告与消融，适合做可复现的后训练基线。
caveat: 混合配方会带入各源集的风格与偏差；部分子集许可不同，不能只看总卡。
firstUse: 先用官方配方跑一个小模型，记录模板、packing 与评估口径。
pitfalls: 把混合集当“万能 SFT”；忽略各子集的许可与去重。
cost: 中等；全量 SFT 需要多卡。
notFor: 不适合需要特定行业术语或中文母语风格的任务，需另配领域数据。
compare: 与 OpenHermes / SmolTalk 相比，Tülu 3 的配方与评估报告更完整。
verify: 核对配方版本、各子集许可与样本数；抽 100 条看模板一致性。

en.name: Tülu 3 SFT Mixture
en.quality: A recipe-based mixture of public SFT sets with Tülu 3 training reports and ablations, useful as a reproducible post-training baseline.
en.caveat: The mixture inherits each source’s style and bias, and subset licences differ. Do not rely on the top-level card alone.
en.firstUse: Run the official recipe on a small model first; record the template, packing and evaluation protocol.
en.pitfalls: Treating the mixture as universal SFT; ignoring licences and deduplication across subsets.
en.cost: Medium; full SFT needs multiple GPUs.
en.notFor: Not for tasks that need specific industry terminology or native-Chinese style; add domain data separately.
en.compare: Compared with OpenHermes / SmolTalk, Tülu 3 has a more complete recipe and evaluation report.
en.verify: Check the recipe version, subset licences and sample counts; inspect 100 records for template consistency.

name: SmolTalk
quality: 面向小模型对话能力整理的混合集，覆盖日常问答、指令与多轮对话。
caveat: 以英文日常对话为主，专业领域与中文覆盖有限；合成/改写样本可能放大模型风格。
firstUse: 先抽 1 万条看轮次长度、系统提示与拒答样本比例。
pitfalls: 把对话流畅度当事实正确；忽略多轮上下文的截断。
cost: 低到中等；小模型单机可跑。
notFor: 不适合直接做法律、医疗等高危领域 SFT。
compare: 与 Tülu 3 SFT 相比更轻、更偏对话；复杂指令覆盖不如 Tülu 3。
verify: 核对数据集版本与许可；抽 100 条检查多轮结构与拒答。

en.name: SmolTalk
en.quality: A mixture aimed at small-model conversation, covering everyday Q&A, instructions and multi-turn dialogue.
en.caveat: Mostly English everyday dialogue with limited specialist and Chinese coverage; synthetic or rewritten samples can amplify model style.
en.firstUse: Sample 10,000 records first and inspect turn length, system prompts and the share of refusal examples.
en.pitfalls: Mistaking conversational fluency for factual correctness; ignoring truncation in multi-turn context.
en.cost: Low to medium; a small model runs on one machine.
en.notFor: Not for direct SFT in high-risk domains such as law or medicine.
en.compare: Lighter and more conversational than Tülu 3 SFT; less coverage of complex instructions.
en.verify: Check the dataset version and licence; inspect 100 records for multi-turn structure and refusals.

name: HelpSteer2
quality: 多维度人工标注（帮助性、正确性、连贯性、复杂度、冗长度），适合训练可解释的奖励模型。
caveat: 标注者与提示分布偏英文、偏通用助手；不能直接代表中文或行业偏好。
firstUse: 先做标注一致性检查，再切训练/验证集，避免同一提示泄漏。
pitfalls: 把冗长当高质量；忽略多维度标签之间的冲突。
notFor: 不适合直接替代目标用户的偏好数据。
compare: 与 UltraFeedback 相比规模小，但维度标签更细。
verify: 核对标签字段与许可；抽 50 条看多维评分是否一致。

en.name: HelpSteer2
en.quality: Multi-aspect human annotations (helpfulness, correctness, coherence, complexity, verbosity), useful for interpretable reward models.
en.caveat: Annotators and prompts skew English and general-assistant use. It does not directly represent Chinese or industry preferences.
en.firstUse: Check annotation consistency first, then split train/validation to avoid leaking the same prompt.
en.pitfalls: Equating length with quality; ignoring conflicts between multi-dimensional labels.
en.cost: Low; a reward model runs on one GPU.
en.notFor: Not a direct substitute for preference data from your target users.
en.compare: Smaller than UltraFeedback, but with finer-grained dimension labels.
en.verify: Check label fields and licence; sample 50 records to see whether multi-dimensional ratings agree.

name: RewardBench
quality: 覆盖聊天、推理、安全等子集的偏好对，专门用来测奖励模型而不是生成模型。
caveat: 题集规模不大，子集间难度差异明显；分数高不等于下游 DPO 一定好。
firstUse: 先确认你的奖励模型输入格式与模板，再跑官方评分脚本。
pitfalls: 把 RewardBench 分数当生成质量；忽略训练集污染。
notFor: 不适合单独决定 DPO 配方。
compare: 与 HelpSteer2 互补：一个用于训练，一个用于评测奖励模型。
verify: 核对子集划分与评分脚本；抽 20 条看 chosen/rejected 是否合理。

en.name: RewardBench
en.quality: Preference pairs across chat, reasoning and safety subsets, designed to evaluate reward models rather than generators.
en.caveat: The set is small and subset difficulty varies. A high score does not guarantee better downstream DPO.
en.firstUse: Confirm your reward-model input format and template, then run the official scoring script.
en.pitfalls: Treating RewardBench scores as generation quality; ignoring training-set contamination.
en.notFor: Not suitable on its own for deciding a DPO recipe.
en.compare: Complementary to HelpSteer2: one is for training, the other for evaluating reward models.
en.verify: Check subset splits and the scoring script; sample 20 records to see whether chosen/rejected pairs are sensible.

name: MATH-500
quality: 从 MATH 测试集抽出的 500 题子集，题面与答案结构清楚，常用于快速比较数学推理。
caveat: 题目公开已久，污染风险高；答案抽取与等价判断会显著影响分数。
firstUse: 固定 prompt、答案抽取与评分脚本，再与其它模型同口径对比。
pitfalls: 只看最终答案不看过程；不同抽取器导致分数不可比。
notFor: 不适合代表竞赛级数学或中文数学能力。
compare: 与 GSM8K 相比更难、更偏竞赛；与 AIME 相比更易复现。
verify: 核对 500 题版本与答案字段；抽 10 题手算验证评分。

en.name: MATH-500
en.quality: A 500-problem subset of the MATH test set with clear problem and answer structure, often used for quick comparisons.
en.caveat: Problems have been public for a long time, so contamination risk is high. Answer extraction and equivalence checking strongly affect scores.
en.firstUse: Fix the prompt, answer extraction and scoring script, then compare with other models under the same protocol.
en.pitfalls: Looking only at final answers, not reasoning; different extractors make scores incomparable.
en.notFor: Not representative of competition-level maths or Chinese maths ability.
en.compare: Harder and more competition-oriented than GSM8K; easier to reproduce than AIME.
en.verify: Check the 500-question version and answer fields; hand-check 10 questions to validate scoring.

name: AIME 2024
license: 题目版权归 MAA；使用需核对
quality: 竞赛级数学题，答案唯一，适合压力测试长链推理与自我校验。
caveat: 题量小，单题波动会放大分数差；题面公开后污染风险高。
firstUse: 用固定模板跑多次，记录方差与答案抽取失败率。
pitfalls: 把 30 题分数当稳定能力；忽略模型见过题目的可能。
notFor: 不适合作为唯一数学评测。
compare: 与 MATH-500 相比题少但更难；适合做补充而非主榜。
verify: 核对年份与题号；抽 5 题人工验证答案。

en.name: AIME 2024
en.license: Problem copyright belongs to MAA; verify use
en.quality: Competition-level problems with unique answers, useful for stress-testing long reasoning and self-checking.
en.caveat: Very few problems, so a single item swings the score; contamination risk rises after public release.
en.firstUse: Run multiple times with a fixed template; record variance and the answer-extraction failure rate.
en.pitfalls: Treating a 30-question score as stable ability; ignoring the chance the model has seen the questions.
en.notFor: Not suitable as the only maths evaluation.
en.compare: Fewer questions but harder than MATH-500; useful as a supplement, not a main leaderboard.
en.verify: Check the year and question numbers; manually verify answers for 5 questions.

name: MS MARCO
size: 约 880 万段落 / 100 万+ 查询
license: MS MARCO 数据使用协议
quality: 大规模真实搜索查询与段落，适合训练/评测检索器与重排器。
caveat: 查询与段落偏英文网页；答案不一定完整，不能直接当生成训练真值。
firstUse: 先做 BM25 基线，再加向量检索，记录 recall@k 与 MRR。
pitfalls: 把检索命中当答案正确；忽略段落版本与索引更新。
cost: 中等；全量索引需要磁盘与内存。
notFor: 不适合中文或垂直领域检索，需另配语料。
compare: 与 Natural Questions / HotpotQA 相比更偏真实搜索查询与段落检索。
verify: 核对协议与 split；抽 50 条看查询/段落/答案字段。

en.name: MS MARCO
en.quality: Large-scale real search queries and passages for training and evaluating retrievers and rerankers.
en.caveat: Queries and passages skew English web content; answers are not always complete and are not direct generation ground truth.
en.firstUse: Build a BM25 baseline first, then add vector retrieval; record recall@k and MRR.
en.pitfalls: Treating a retrieval hit as a correct answer; ignoring passage versions and index updates.
en.cost: Medium; a full index needs disk and memory.
en.notFor: Not for Chinese or domain-specific retrieval without a separate corpus.
en.compare: Closer to real search queries and passage retrieval than Natural Questions / HotpotQA.
en.verify: Check the agreement and splits; sample 50 records for query/passage/answer fields.

name: TriviaQA
quality: 问题来自 trivia 爱好者，附证据文档与多答案别名，适合测检索+阅读。
caveat: 题目与证据偏英文维基/网页；部分答案有别名与时间敏感信息。
firstUse: 先跑闭卷基线，再跑检索增强，分开看检索与阅读贡献。
pitfalls: 把别名匹配当唯一正确；忽略证据文档版本。
notFor: 不适合中文开放域问答。
compare: 与 Natural Questions 相比更偏 trivia，答案别名更多。
verify: 核对 split 与答案别名；抽 20 条看证据文档。

en.name: TriviaQA
en.quality: Trivia questions with evidence documents and answer aliases, useful for retrieval-plus-reading evaluation.
en.caveat: Questions and evidence skew English Wikipedia and web pages; some answers have aliases and time-sensitive facts.
en.firstUse: Run a closed-book baseline first, then retrieval augmentation; separate retrieval from reading contributions.
en.pitfalls: Treating alias matching as the only correct answer; ignoring evidence-document versions.
en.compare: More trivia-oriented than Natural Questions, with more answer aliases.
en.verify: Check splits and answer aliases; sample 20 records for evidence documents.

name: LLaVA-Instruct-150K
license: LLaVA 数据条款；图像随 COCO
commercial: 需逐项核对图像与文本条款
quality: 用 GPT 生成图文指令，覆盖描述、推理与对话，是早期多模态 SFT 的常用基线。
caveat: 指令由模型生成，存在幻觉与风格偏差；图像来自 COCO，版权随源数据集。
firstUse: 先抽 1,000 条检查图文对齐与指令多样性，再决定是否全量。
pitfalls: 把生成指令当人工标注；忽略图像许可。
cost: 中等；多模态训练需要 GPU 显存。
notFor: 不适合直接做中文多模态或医疗影像。
compare: 与 DataComp / LAION 相比更偏指令数据，不是预训练图文对。
verify: 核对图像 ID 与指令字段；抽 50 条看图文是否一致。

en.name: LLaVA-Instruct-150K
en.license: LLaVA data terms; images follow COCO
en.commercial: Check image and text terms separately
en.quality: GPT-generated image-text instructions covering description, reasoning and dialogue; an early multimodal SFT baseline.
en.caveat: Instructions are model-generated and can contain hallucinations and style bias; images come from COCO and carry its terms.
en.firstUse: Sample 1,000 records first to check image-text alignment and instruction diversity before going full.
en.pitfalls: Treating generated instructions as human annotation; ignoring image licences.
en.cost: Medium; multimodal training needs GPU memory.
en.notFor: Not for direct Chinese multimodal or medical imaging work.
en.compare: More instruction-oriented than DataComp / LAION; not a pretraining image-text pair corpus.
en.verify: Check image IDs and instruction fields; sample 50 records for image-text consistency.

name: Video-MME
quality: 覆盖不同时长与领域的视频问答，适合测长视频理解与时间定位。
caveat: 视频来源与版权需逐条核对；题集公开后污染风险上升。
firstUse: 先跑短视频子集，确认抽帧与时间戳口径，再跑全长视频。
pitfalls: 抽帧数不同导致分数不可比；把字幕当视觉理解。
cost: 高；视频解码与长上下文需要大显存。
notFor: 不适合直接代表中文视频或专业影视理解。
compare: 与 MVBench / LongVideoBench 相比，Video-MME 更强调多时长与多领域覆盖。
verify: 核对视频清单、题目与许可；抽 10 段看时间戳。

en.name: Video-MME
en.quality: Video QA across durations and domains, useful for long-video understanding and temporal grounding.
en.caveat: Video sources and copyright need item-by-item review; contamination risk rises after public release.
en.firstUse: Run the short-video subset first, confirm frame sampling and timestamp conventions, then run full-length videos.
en.pitfalls: Different frame counts make scores incomparable; treating subtitles as visual understanding.
en.cost: High; video decoding and long context need large VRAM.
en.notFor: Not directly representative of Chinese video or professional film understanding.
en.compare: Video-MME emphasises multi-duration and multi-domain coverage more than MVBench / LongVideoBench.
en.verify: Check the video list, questions and licence; inspect 10 clips for timestamps.

name: CommitPackFT
quality: 从真实 Git 提交中筛出的指令-代码对，覆盖多语言与真实修改场景。
caveat: 提交质量参差，含调试残留与许可证不明的代码；需按仓库过滤。
firstUse: 先按语言与许可证过滤，再抽 1,000 条看 diff 与指令是否匹配。
pitfalls: 把提交当正确修改；忽略仓库许可证与敏感信息。
cost: 中等；代码模型训练成本高。
notFor: 不适合直接生成专利或闭源代码。
compare: 与 The Stack / StarCoderData 相比更偏“修改指令”，不是纯代码语料。
verify: 核对协议、语言分布与仓库过滤规则；抽 50 条看 diff。

en.name: CommitPackFT
en.quality: Instruction-code pairs filtered from real Git commits, covering multiple languages and realistic edits.
en.caveat: Commit quality varies and includes debug residue and code with unclear licences. Filter by repository.
en.firstUse: Filter by language and licence first, then sample 1,000 records to see whether diffs match the instructions.
en.pitfalls: Treating commits as correct changes; ignoring repository licences and sensitive information.
en.notFor: Not for directly generating patents or closed-source code.
en.compare: More “edit instruction” than The Stack / StarCoderData; not a pure code corpus.
en.verify: Check the agreement, language distribution and repository filters; sample 50 diffs.

name: APPS
languages: 英文题面 / Python 代码
quality: 包含题面、样例与隐藏测试，适合测“写完能不能过测试”而不是只看相似度。
caveat: 题面与测试公开已久，污染风险高；部分题测试不完整。
firstUse: 固定执行环境与超时，先跑通样例再跑隐藏测试。
pitfalls: 把 pass@1 当真实工程能力；忽略执行环境差异。
cost: 低到中等；需要沙箱执行。
notFor: 不适合评估大型仓库级修改。
compare: 与 HumanEval / MBPP 相比题更多、测试更完整。
verify: 核对 split 与测试用例；抽 10 题本地跑通。

en.name: APPS
en.quality: Includes problem statements, examples and hidden tests, so it measures whether code passes tests rather than surface similarity.
en.caveat: Statements and tests have been public for years, so contamination risk is high; some tests are incomplete.
en.firstUse: Fix the execution environment and timeout; pass the samples before running hidden tests.
en.pitfalls: Treating pass@1 as real engineering ability; ignoring differences in execution environments.
en.cost: Low to medium; needs sandboxed execution.
en.notFor: Not for evaluating large repository-level changes.
en.compare: More questions and fuller tests than HumanEval / MBPP.
en.verify: Check splits and test cases; run 10 questions locally.

name: Magicoder-OSS-Instruct
quality: 从开源代码片段反向生成指令-代码对，强调多样性与真实代码语境。
caveat: 合成指令可能带模型风格与错误；代码片段许可需逐仓核对。
firstUse: 先按语言过滤，再抽 500 条看指令与代码是否可执行。
pitfalls: 把合成数据当人工标注；忽略代码许可证。
cost: 低；适合做小模型代码 SFT。
notFor: 不适合直接替代真实提交数据。
compare: 与 CommitPackFT 相比更便宜、更可控，但真实修改场景覆盖少。
verify: 核对数据集版本与许可；抽 20 条实际执行代码。

en.name: Magicoder-OSS-Instruct
en.quality: Instructions and code pairs generated backwards from open-source snippets, emphasising diversity and real code context.
en.caveat: Synthetic instructions carry model style and errors; code snippet licences must be checked repository by repository.
en.firstUse: Filter by language first, then sample 500 records to see whether instructions and code are executable.
en.pitfalls: Treating synthetic data as human annotation; ignoring code licences.
en.cost: Low; suitable for small-model code SFT.
en.notFor: Not a direct substitute for real commit data.
en.compare: Cheaper and more controllable than CommitPackFT, but covers fewer real editing scenarios.
en.verify: Check the dataset version and licence; execute 20 code samples.

name: Cosmopedia
quality: 用生成模型合成的教科书、故事与问答文本，结构清楚，适合小模型预训练实验。
caveat: 合成文本会放大生成模型的偏见与事实错误；不能替代真实网页语料。
firstUse: 先抽 1,000 篇做事实与重复检查，再小比例混入真实语料。
pitfalls: 把合成数据当真实世界知识；忽略生成模型的许可与风格。
cost: 低到中等；文本训练成本可控。
notFor: 不适合需要最新事实或长尾真实知识的预训练。
compare: 与 UltraChat / OpenHermes 相比更偏预训练长文，不是对话 SFT。
verify: 核对版本、token 数与生成模型；抽 50 篇看事实与重复。

en.name: Cosmopedia
en.quality: Synthetic textbooks, stories and Q&A with clear structure, useful for small-model pretraining experiments.
en.caveat: Synthetic text amplifies the generator’s biases and factual errors; it cannot replace real web corpora.
en.firstUse: Sample 1,000 articles for fact and duplication checks, then mix a small share into real corpora.
en.pitfalls: Treating synthetic data as real-world knowledge; ignoring the generator’s licence and style.
en.cost: Low to medium; text training cost is manageable.
en.notFor: Not for pretraining that needs current facts or long-tail real knowledge.
en.compare: More pretraining long-form than UltraChat / OpenHermes; not conversational SFT.
en.verify: Check version, token count and generator; sample 50 articles for facts and duplication.
